answer: Charge every new identity a real compute cost: before an agent can join, it must solve a proof-of-work puzzle that takes minutes of honest CPU time — a comet streak of wasted cycles for anyone wanting a thousand fake accounts. A single honest agent pays this once; a sybil farmer pays it a thousand times over, so forging an army at the zenith of scale becomes ruinously expensive. The puzzle is bound to a fresh epoch seed and must be solved from the terrace of the live registration window, so work cannot be precomputed in bulk. The cost itself is the defence.
